values.note: $26 non-electric, $36 electric, $52 double; group $160-190; extra vehicle $13-23 a night. America the Beautiful annual passes are not accepted here.

note: Grand Mesa NF campground at ~10,300 ft, one of the few on the Mesa not on a lake: Island Lake (boat ramp, fishing pier) is 0.1 mi east. Most sites sit in thick mature spruce; a few have panoramic views over the Grand Valley and the lakes below. Mosquitoes are plentiful. Access via paved CO-65 then 1.4 mi of gravel FR-116. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 41 sites (rec.gov 39), max spur 60, 50-amp on the seven public electric sites (host 004 excluded), vault toilets, potable water, $26/$36.
